title: 12 Best Ways to Wander the Medieval Stone Walls and Hidden Piazzas of Kotor's Car-Free, UNESCO-Listed Old Town.
description: Explore the best ways to discover Kotor's ancient city walls, climb to San Giovanni Fortress, and uncover charming hidden piazzas. Dive into UNESCO-listed history, local eateries, and breathtaking views of the Bay of Kotor.
category: Ways to Wander the Medieval Stone Walls and Hidden Piazzas

places.name: Kotor City Walls / San Giovanni Fortress
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Bring water and wear sturdy shoes for the climb.

places.name: St. Tryphon Cathedral
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Visit the upper floor for a closer look at the frescoes and views over the square.

places.name: Maritime Museum of Montenegro
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Allow at least an hour to fully appreciate the various collections.

places.name: Square of the Arms (Trg od Oružja)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A traditional Montenegrin coffee at one of the outdoor cafes.

places.name: Konoba Scala Santa
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The 'Black Risotto' (Crni Rižot) or the 'Seafood Platter' are exceptional.

places.name: Cat Museum (Muzej Mačaka)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Pick up a unique cat-themed souvenir for a good cause.

places.name: Caffe Pizzeria Pronto
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Any of their freshly baked pizzas; the 'Pronto Special' is a local favorite.

places.name: Galerija
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The grilled octopus or their daily fish special are highly recommended.

places.name: Letrika Caffe Bar
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Try their signature cocktails or a local Montenegrin beer.

places.name: Forza Gelateria
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their pistachio and dark chocolate flavors are incredibly rich and satisfying.

places.name: Konoba Akustik
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Order a platter of mixed grilled meats (Miješano meso) to share and experience a variety of local flavors.

places.name: Church of St. Nicholas (Crkva Sv. Nikole)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Observe the intricate details of the iconostasis, often considered the highlight of Orthodox churches.

tags: Ways to Wander the Medieval Stone Walls and Hidden Piazzas
